title: BreEStim Pre-trial
official: A Randomized, Double-blind, Sham-controlled, Parallel-group Trial Designed to Evaluate the Efficacy of BreEStim in Managing Neuropathic Pain After SCI - a Pre-trial Study
summary: The overall goal is to evaluate the effectiveness of different stimulation protocol of a novel intervention - Breathing-controlled electrical stimulation (BreEStim) in managing neuropathic pain after spinal cord injury (SCI).
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston

sites.f: The University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston
